hero.headline:
X-Ray Imaging
Software Products
hero.tagline: Decades of software expertise — available as licensable components or integrated with Athlos imaging systems.

overview.headline: The software layer behind direct conversion imaging.
overview.body1: The Athlos team has been developing X-ray imaging software since the early days of direct conversion — reconstruction algorithms, image processing filters, and TWAIN integration layers that have been deployed in thousands of clinical and industrial installations worldwide.
overview.body2: These software capabilities are available as part of a complete Athlos imaging system, or as independently licensable components for integration into third-party platforms. Athlos also provides SDK access and direct integration support for OEM and system integrator customers.

components.headline: Software components for imaging system development.

twain.title: TWAIN Module
twain.body: The Athlos TWAIN module integrates directly with dental and medical imaging software. Supported applications include Dentrix Ascend, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Dexis, Romexis, and many more TWAIN-enabled platforms. Available as part of a hardware solution or as a standalone licensed component.

reconstruction.title: Reconstruction Algorithms
reconstruction.body: Advanced reconstruction algorithm libraries developed over decades of direct conversion imaging work. Designed for the specific signal characteristics of CdTe and Si CMOS detectors. Available as a standalone licensable component for integration into imaging system pipelines.

postProcessing.title: Post-Processing Filters
postProcessing.body: Locally adaptive image enhancement and post-processing filter libraries. Developed and refined across dental, industrial, and medical imaging applications. Provided with the Athlos SDK and available for integration and customisation.

sdkApi.title: Athlos SDK & API
sdkApi.body: C/C++ and DLL integration APIs with source-code examples, an evaluation GUI, and an advanced locally adaptive filter library. Contact Athlos for SDK access and licensing terms.

cta.headline: Software licensing and integration questions.
cta.body: Whether you are integrating Athlos software into an existing platform or evaluating it for a new imaging system, the Athlos team can support you. Contact us to discuss licensing, SDK access, and integration paths.
